app.name: Personal Bookmark Manager
signIn.headline: Every link you keep, in one place.
signIn.lede: Save a link once, file it in a folder and tag it. Your bookmarks stay yours: no one else sees them, on any device you sign in from.
signIn.note: Signing up, a new password and a forgotten one all happen on the sign-in page. The same sign-in opens every app in this project.
signIn.failed: Sign-in couldn't be opened. Please try again.
bookmarks.title: Your bookmarks
bookmarks.sub: Everything you have saved, newest first, sorted into folders and tags.
bookmarks.bandNote: Saved newest first. Open a folder on the right to narrow the list.
bookmarks.folderHint: Up to 60 characters. Names are yours alone.
bookmarks.emptyTitle: No bookmarks yet. Save your first link.
bookmarks.emptyText: Paste a link, pick a folder, add tags. It lands here newest first.
bookmarks.emptyFolderText: Save a link into this folder and it shows here.
bookmarks.loadFailed: Your bookmarks couldn't be loaded. Please try again.
bookmarks.emptyFolders: No folders yet. Make your first one.
bookmarks.duplicateFolder: You already have a folder called {name}.
bookmarks.folderFailed: The folder couldn't be saved. Please try again.
auth.notConfigured: Sign-in isn't set up for this app yet.
auth.subtitle: Continue with your account to keep your bookmarks.
signIn.buttonSignUp: Sign in or create an account
signIn.noteSignUp: Creating an account, a new password and a forgotten one all happen on the sign-in page. The same sign-in opens every app in this project.
